tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and conditions as per the tender doc
Conditions are uploaded in Tender notification

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.
Negative value of service charge are not allowed
Bidder should Quote rate in percentage
Bidder Should bid the Service charge in Percentage (%) and it should be above 2%
If the bidder bid the service charge below or equal to 2% to the APT that bidder will be disqualified without any explanation

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Affidavit of self declaration for firm non blacklisted Rs 100 stamp paper
Agency should have a Service Tax Registration, Provident Fund Registration, Employee state Insurance Registration, Professional Tax Registration & PAN card & GST Registration
Agency should have Income tax returns for Last Five Financial years
Agency should have Labour Licence Registration Certificate as per contract labour Regulation and Abolition act 1970
Agency should have Local Firm and Registration Address , Land phone number, Mobile number and tax paid reciept
Applicant agency should be Supplying of minimum 26 Manpower at any district of Karnataka Work done certificates from not lower than Executive Engineer in last five years ie 2021-22 to 2025-26
Audit report for Profit and Loss A/C and Balance Sheet for the Last Five Financial years
ESI Returns and Challans 2025-26 Minimum 26 Employee Challans to be enclosed
Karnataka Labour Welfare Fund 1965 Act Remitted Contribution receipts per year for minimum 26 workers in last 3 years Remitted receipts should be before tender notification date

The agency should have yearly turnover not less than Two times the amount put to tender price of Rs.567980.00 in any Two financial years out of last 5 financial years.i.e 2021-22 to 2025-26 Turn over Certificate Certified by Chartered Accountant with UDIN No
